description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bediwewathe, Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120285 (7621)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It specifically addresses changes to land ownership records, transferring titles from private individuals to the State, and includes detailed land parcel information (block numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and license details). This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership changes, and land title matters.
